backend: Python packed spatial recurrence, local QP transition oracle, and scalar-cell witness crosscheck

limitations: Only four named words; no frontier membership or occurrence census.
A completed cycle certifies the exact rational phase values; reported periods need not be least for each phase.
Truncation absence concerns only the recorded finite scan, not all truncations, phases after multiple cycles, or integers.
No conclusion about B_all or actual fringe periodicity; a finite witness would refute only the bitlength-only strengthening.
Timing excludes final result serialization and atomic writes.

limits.enforcement: one CPU affinity; RLIMIT_CPU; RLIMIT_AS; outer timeout 120s

parameters.phase_bit_order: bit j is phase j; successor j+1 modulo p
parameters.rational_encoding: A+2^a*C/(1-2^lambda), plus reduced signed hex numerator/positive hex denominator
parameters.state_order: V[n-2],V[n-1],V[n],V[n+1], oldest in low packed bits
parameters.truncations: X_phase mod 2^N; N=1..a+lambda inclusive, increasing N then phase; deduplicate integers within each q; stop at first witness
parameters.zero_runs: cyclic aligned base4 period; length lambda/gcd(lambda,2), first even bit >= a

verification.boundary: packed forward QP triangular solve all four exceptional bit positions
verification.cycle: closing four-vector equality; all transitions checked; deterministic recurrence gives all future transitions
verification.independent_record: lead-owned record not read or used as input; expected periods supplied in conversation only
verification.phase_equations: forward packed QP at all bits through one preperiod+period+4
verification.transitions: every generated transition compared to per-phase forward packed QP bit4 lookup
verification.witness: independent scalar local rule for every forced transition, exact full prefix with unobserved final u

hypothesis: Periodic auxiliary survivor spatial cycles give exact rational comparators; their named finite truncations test the bit-length-only boundary strengthening.

integration.documentation_input_scope: Contributor input_sha256 entries are run-time documentation snapshots, not computational inputs. These notes may change as results are integrated. The operative inputs are the four literal words, maps, caps and truncation order in the embedded executed source.
integration.primary_replay: Original executed source uses the recorded absolute checkout path and writes atomically beside its extracted source; extract outside the repository. Independent verification uses checkout-relative paths.
integration.raw_data_embedded: All raw data are present in result_summary; no temporary file is required to inspect or verify them.
